# DestiX AI | Autonomous Telephony & AI Voice Infrastructure Practice (https://ayush.company)

> DestiX AI is an independent enterprise AI voice engineering and autonomous systems practice based in Connaught Place, New Delhi 110001, India, founded and directed by Principal AI Systems Architect Ayush Meena. The practice builds carrier-grade, sub-500ms voice agents, self-hosted n8n/Make CRM orchestration clusters, and category-defining 3D WebGL digital storefronts for high-ticket real estate developers, healthcare networks, financial advisory desks, and enterprise B2B operations globally.

## 4 Core Engineering Practices
1. Autonomous Voice Telephony Infrastructure (https://ayush.company/voice-agents)
   - Audited Latency: 435ms P50 roundtrip voice turnaround (sub-500ms human perceptual threshold).
   - Audio Stack: Silero VAD v4 (120ms silence cutoff) + WebRTC Hardware AEC, Deepgram Nova-3 Streaming WebSocket (110ms STT), Groq Llama 3.3 70B Versatile / Anthropic Claude 3.5 Sonnet token streaming (95ms TTFT), Cartesia Sonic / Deepgram Aura-2 chunk streaming (90ms audio return).
   - Speed-to-Lead: Under 15-45 seconds automated outbound call trigger from portal webhooks (99acres, MagicBricks, Housing.com, Meta Lead Ads, Google Ads).
   - Inbound Reception: Zero-hold 24/7 phone answering under 2 rings with sub-180ms user speech interruption recovery.
   - Domestic & Global SIP Trunks: Tier-1 TRAI/DLT compliant +91 mobile virtual numbers, 011 Delhi, and 0124 Gurugram PRI landline trunks via Tata Telecommunications, Airtel, and Exotel; +971 TDRA DIDs via du/Etisalat; +44 20 Ofcom DIDs via BT/Gamma Telecom; +1 212/305/310 STIR/SHAKEN Level A DIDs via Twilio/Telnyx.
   - Languages: Fluent code-switching across English, Hindi, colloquial Hinglish, Tamil, Tanglish, Telugu, Marathi, Kannada, Arabic, and Spanish.

2. Enterprise AI Operating System & Business Process Automation (https://ayush.company/services/autonomous-agents)
   - Orchestration: Sovereign self-hosted n8n Docker clusters running on client private cloud VPCs, slashing recurring automation costs by 80-95% compared to Zapier/Make.
   - CRM Telephony Pipelines: Bi-directional sub-2-second synchronization connecting calls and WhatsApp to Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, LeadSquared, Follow Up Boss, and GoHighLevel.
   - WhatsApp Automation: Under 5-second automated brochure, gate-pass, and site visit confirmation dispatch via Meta WhatsApp Business Cloud API.
   - Multilingual RAG Chatbots: Deterministic vector search (pgvector/Pinecone) with hybrid sparse/dense retrieval, zero hallucination guardrails, and human desk handoff.
   - Multi-Agent Systems: Production LangGraph state machines and multi-agent swarms executing document triage, automated research, and lead revival.

3. Spatial 3D WebGL Architecture & Digital Flagships (https://ayush.company/websites)
   - Architecture: Custom Next.js 15 App Router paired with Three.js / WebGL 60 FPS interactive GLSL shaders.
   - Performance: 99/100 Lighthouse performance, 0.00 Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS), sub-1.2s Largest Contentful Paint (LCP).
   - Commercial Impact: +340% average user dwell time (4.2 minutes) and 3.2x consultation conversion lift on high-ticket luxury property and enterprise launches.

4. Agency White-Label & Ghost Partner Program (https://ayush.company/partners/agency-white-label)
   - Turnkey conversational telephony and automation infrastructure for marketing agencies, IT consultancies, and growth studios.
   - Complete white-label deployment under partner brand with dedicated multi-tenant isolation, carrier wholesale pass-through, and high recurring margins.

## Commercial Moats & Unit Economics
- 100% Client Code & IP Ownership: Clients own all prompts, n8n workflow JSON, custom state machines, vector embeddings, and carrier accounts. Zero proprietary vendor lock-in or recurring software seat taxes.
- Carrier Wholesale Pass-Through:
  * India: ~₹4.50 to ₹7.50 per conversation minute (Tata Tele, Airtel Enterprise, Exotel).
  * Global (US/UK/UAE/EU): $0.02 to $0.06 per conversation minute.
  * Effective Voice Cost: ~$0.065/minute total effective cost vs $0.30/min SaaS platform wrappers and $1.20/min manual call center seats.
  * Software Platform Markup: Exactly 0% markup on raw telephony and inference compute.
- Strict 5x Hurdle Rate ROI Guarantee: DestiX AI requires an audited 5x projected return on investment before accepting any enterprise engagement. If the deployment fails to hit agreed contractual revenue or efficiency benchmarks, engineering continues at zero charge until achieved.

## Regulatory Compliance & Telecommunications Architecture (https://ayush.company/compliance)
- India Practice: Full compliance with TRAI TCCCPR 2018 regulations. Dedicated 140-series (promotional/telemarketing) and 160-series (transactional/service) DIDs. Enterprise DLT header and template registration, automated DND (Do Not Disturb) scrubbing, Airtel PRI and Tata Tele SIP interconnects.
- UAE Practice: Full TDRA compliance, provisioned +971 virtual landline/toll-free DIDs via du and e& (Etisalat) SIP gateways, RERA real estate ad permit alignment.
- UK Practice: Full Ofcom compliance regarding persistent misuse and silent calls. +44 20 London geographic DIDs, TPS/CTPS registry scrubbing, UK GDPR Article 22 compliant human-escalation pathways.
- USA Practice: Full FCC / TCPA compliance, STIR/SHAKEN Level A attestation on +1 212/305/310 DIDs preventing carrier spam flags, CCPA consumer privacy safeguards, calling window governance (8 AM - 9 PM local).
- European Union Practice: Article 50 EU AI Act transparency notification, GDPR Article 22 human-in-the-loop fallback safeguards, zero-retention sovereign VPC cloud hosting options in Frankfurt (eu-central-1) and Dublin (eu-west-1).
- Data Privacy Architecture: Call audio is streamed in-memory via WebRTC/WebSocket; transcripts and structured data are extracted into sovereign client CRMs. Zero persistent audio retention by third parties.
